basis: Revenue grew 11.6% to a record, but Q4 diluted EPS fell 11% and adjusted EPS slipped to $0.85 from $0.87, with a 160bp adjusted EBITDA margin compression blamed on training and delivery-mix costs. The FY27 guidance numbers are cut off in the text ('continued strong revenue and adjusted EBITDA growth'), so the size is modest. The credit-facility extensions are routine.
